name: joplin-plugin-knowledge-graph
description: Interactive knowledge graph visualization for Joplin notes

scripts.dist: npm run fetch-model && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildMain && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=buildExtraScripts && webpack --env joplin-plugin-config=createArchive
scripts.install-local: npm run dist && cp publish/com.seanhinds.knowledge-graph.jpl "${HOME}/.config/joplin-desktop/plugins/com.seanhinds.knowledge-graph.jpl" && echo 'Installed to Joplin plugins dir — restart Joplin to load.'
